{
  "name": "comprehende",
  "version": "0.7.0",
  "description": "Local review assistant that groups git diffs so humans can comprehend AI code changes.",
  "type": "module",
  "bin": {
    "comprehende": "./dist/cli/main.js"
  },
  "files": [
    "dist",
    "skills"
  ],
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build",
    "prepack": "pnpm run build",
    "dev": "tsx src/cli/main.ts",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p src/ui/tsconfig.json",
    "test": "tsx --test \"src/**/*.test.ts\"",
    "fixture": "tsx scripts/build-fixture.ts",
    "generate:schema": "tsx scripts/generate-review-schema.ts",
    "sync:skill": "tsx scripts/sync-skill.ts",
    "release:skill": "tsx scripts/sync-skill.ts --release",
    "check:skill": "tsx scripts/check-skill-sync.ts",
    "pack:smoke": "tsx scripts/pack-smoke.ts",
    "prepare": "node scripts/install-git-hooks.js"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=24"
  },
  "packageManager": "pnpm@12.3.4+sha512.961aa41fb077da3a04a441d9f8e15ebc0c96da8ef710b2eb67bf9ee7cb0610eabd48f1fd85f51cffe73846785fa0f87c56a3a872a1d893f8446741b5cce45457",
  "license": "MIT",
  "author": "Máté Molnár",
  "keywords": [
    "code-review",
    "git",
    "diff",
    "cli",
    "skill"
  ],
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende.git"
  },
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/issues"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende#readme",
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@fontsource-variable/bricolage-grotesque": "^5.3.0",
    "@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono": "^5.3.0",
    "@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans": "^5.3.0",
    "@pierre/diffs": "^1.4.1",
    "@radix-ui/react-dialog": "^1.1.23",
    "@radix-ui/react-separator": "^1.1.15",
    "@radix-ui/react-slot": "^1.3.3",
    "@radix-ui/react-toggle": "^1.1.18",
    "@radix-ui/react-tooltip": "^1.2.16",
    "@tailwindcss/vite": "^4.3.3",
    "@types/node": "^24.13.3",
    "@types/react": "^19.2.7",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.2.7",
    "@vitejs/plugin-react": "^6.1.1",
    "class-variance-authority": "^0.7.1",
    "clsx": "^2.1.1",
    "lucide-react": "^1.41.0",
    "react": "^19.2.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.2.0",
    "react-markdown": "^10.1.0",
    "react-resizable-panels": "^4.12.3",
    "tailwind-merge": "^3.6.0",
    "tailwindcss": "^4.3.3",
    "tsx": "^4.23.13",
    "tw-animate-css": "^1.4.0",
    "typescript": "^7.0.2",
    "vite": "^8.2.2"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "zod": "^4.5.4"
  }
}
